title: Local Guarded Executor CLI Proposal
claim: FP-MCP-322 should add a local-only MCP bridge CLI that can execute the existing guarded canary sequencer/executor path from the operator host, write a full result JSON artifact, and preserve the same one-gate-at-a-time and one-final-attempt boundaries without routing the final execution boundary through ChatGPT tools.
summary: FP-MCP-321 moved the final runner-start boundary to local operator handoff after repeated ChatGPT platform safety blocks. FP-MCP-322 should implement a narrow local CLI in the MCP bridge that imports existing guarded executor code rather than duplicating gate logic. The CLI should require an input JSON file, call the same guarded executor once, write a result JSON file, and exit. It must not create broad direct runner-start access or unbounded retries.
caveats: This proposal does not execute the final runner-start attempt.
The CLI implementation must not weaken existing approval, clearance, enablement, or sequencer gates.
The first use of the CLI for the final attempt must use fresh short-lived artifacts.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint contact by this checkpoint.
No approval consumption by this checkpoint.
No OpenCode start by this checkpoint.
No canary execution by this checkpoint.
The proposed CLI must call the guarded executor once per invocation and then stop.

proposedSourceSupport: export/register existing guarded runner-start handler without starting the server
read input JSON from a file
write full result JSON to an explicit output path
nonGoals: no automatic long-lived clearance or enablement

observedResult: FP-MCP-322 should add a local-only MCP bridge CLI that can execute the existing guarded canary sequencer/executor path from the operator host, write a full result JSON artifact, and preserve the same one-gate-at-a-time and one-final-attempt boundaries without routing the final execution boundary through ChatGPT tools.
